snippet.title: Mightreya - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Former Devil May Cry developer Wazen K shows off his new solo-developed effort, the anime-inspired fast-action game Mightreya, in this new gameplay trailer where you fight monsters from other dimensions. Wishlist Mightreya on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077640/MIGHTREYA/
